Design: 20 experiments per edited hyperparameter. Each experiment starts from a mid-grid base configuration (alpha 4.64e-06, batch 25, depth 2, lr 0.00167, width 101). Each edit is then repeated with one other hyperparameter set to its low extreme and its high extreme. The pairs focus on the most plausible interactions: learning rate with batch size, depth and width; regularization with model size; and edits at the edges of each grid.
